tagline: Finding your way through grants and funding
h1: Grants, vouchers and funding in one place
lede: European, national and regional grants for Italian citizens and businesses, including not-yet-incorporated ones, updated daily and filterable by region, province and sector.
newsletter_lede: Sign up and get notified when a grant matching your filters is published. No spam: unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter_success: Check your email to confirm your subscription.
newsletter_confirmed: Subscription confirmed. You'll get an email when a matching grant is published.
newsletter_unsubscribed: Subscription cancelled. You will no longer receive notifications.
canali_lede: The official channels our daily process checks to find new grants, vouchers and funding across Italy.
footer_disclaimer: Information is provided for guidance only: always check requirements on the issuing body's official website before applying.
cookie_text: We use only technical cookies needed for the site, and, if accepted, one to remember your language. No advertising tracking.
